name: claim_master_position_id
xsql:
SELECT Nvl(MAX(po.master_position_id), 0) AS master_position_id
FROM   xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position po
    ON po.position_id = ppa.position_id
WHERE  ppa.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
  AND  po.incent_st_date IS NOT NULL
